bias.en: Rebound fading · rejected near $156, holding the 10-day
bias.zh: 反弹减弱 · $156 附近受阻，守住 10 日均线

read.en: The Nasdaq ADS fell 1.0% on Nov 2 to $147.71, trading between $146.29 and $156.06, with no 100-day yet (81 sessions). It is below the rising 5-day ($153.8) and falling 30-day ($165.2) averages and just above the rising 10-day ($146.3). MACD has been above its signal since Oct 28, below zero, histogram narrowing; Parabolic SAR has been bullish since Oct 28 ($132.86), and RSI is 44.
read.zh: 纳斯达克 ADS 11月2日下跌 1.0%，收于 $147.71，盘中区间 $146.29–156.06；上市仅 81 个交易日，尚无 100 日均线。股价位于上行的 5 日（$153.8）和下行的 30 日均线（$165.2）下方，略高于上行的 10 日均线（$146.3）。MACD 自 10月28日起位于信号线上方，仍在零轴下方，柱状图收窄；抛物线 SAR 自 10月28日起看多（$132.86），RSI 为 44。

read.en: A push to $156.06 cleared the $152.4–152.8 resistance before fading; the $146.9–148.5 support held. Resistance is $152.4–153.8 (Oct 14 high, 5-day), then $156.1–157.7 (Nov 2 high, Oct 28 and Sep 3 lows) and $165.2–166.1 (30-day, Oct 28 high). Support is $146.3–146.9 (10-day, Nov 2 low), then $145.3–145.6 and $139.2–139.9. A close above $157.7 would target $165; below $145.3, $139–140.

r.en: Nov 2 high $156.06; Oct 28 low $156.5; Sep 3 low $157.7

bias.en: Rebound resuming · reclaimed ₩1.44 million, capped at the 200-day
bias.zh: 反弹恢复 · 收复 144 万韩元，受制于 200 日均线

read.en: SK hynix closed at ₩1,472,000 in Seoul, up 3.8% in the latest Seoul session (₩1,389,000–1,498,000). It is just below the rising 5-day (₩1,475,000) and 200-day (₩1,500,335), above the rising 10-day (₩1,378,500), below the falling 30-day (₩1,553,933) and 100-day (₩1,822,750). MACD has been above signal since Oct 27, below zero, histogram widening; Parabolic SAR has been bullish since Oct 26 (₩1,255,590), and RSI is 49.
read.zh: SK 海力士在首尔收于 ₩1,472,000，最新一个首尔交易日上涨 3.8%（区间 ₩1,389,000–1,498,000）。股价略低于上行的 5 日（₩1,475,000）和 200 日均线（₩1,500,335），位于上行的 10 日均线（₩1,378,500）上方，并低于下行的 30 日（₩1,553,933）和 100 日均线（₩1,822,750）。MACD 自 10月27日起位于信号线上方，仍在零轴下方，柱状图扩大；抛物线 SAR 自 10月26日起看多（₩1,255,590），RSI 为 49。

read.en: The gain reclaimed the ₩1,438,000–1,449,000 resistance, now support, after a dip to ₩1,389,000 held; the ₩1,498,000 high stopped at the 200-day. Resistance is ₩1,495,000–1,500,335 (200-day, Oct 27, Oct 13 and latest-session highs), then ₩1,553,933–1,587,000 (30-day, Sep 2 low, Oct 28 high). Support is ₩1,449,000, then ₩1,378,500–1,389,000 and ₩1,358,000. A close above ₩1,500,000 would target ₩1.55–1.59 million; below ₩1.44 million, ₩1.38 million.

r.en: 200-day average ₩1,500,335; Oct 27, Oct 13 and latest-session highs (₩1,495,000–1,498,000)
